summary: Created and verified `desk:apps:book`; it saves names to `desk:guestbook` and reloads them newest first. The guest book now contains the test entry `Ada`.

files.desk:apps:book:
app 'Guest Book'
task start()
set names to []
when exists('desk:guestbook')
set names to lines(read('desk:guestbook'))
done
give {names: names, name: ''}
done
task key(s, k)
when k is 'enter'
when count(s.name) > 0
add('desk:guestbook', s.name)
add s.name to s.names
set s.name to ''
done
or when k is 'backspace'
set s.name to edit_text(s.name, k)
otherwise
set s.name to edit_text(s.name, k)
done
give s
done
task draw(s)
title('Guest Book')
show(1, 1, count(s.names) & ' guests')
set row to 3
for each n in reverse(s.names)
when row < 23
show(row, 1, n)
set row to row + 1
done
done
show(23, 1, 'name: ' & s.name)
help('Type name  Enter save  Backspace erase')
done
